title: Hazel and the Wreck
author: E. M. Montrose
blurb: Sebastian Hartwell, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the dry season ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
